_about: Generated by env/generate_aplus_tasks.py from env/fixtures/tee_claim.json. Do not hand edit.
Seed 1000, draw 2124456, brand Wexcombe, the tee-only market of design B
The question templates word for word: the eight tee questions of the A+ protocol, tee-
xs-price and tee-promo-check, and three the block should not plan (delivery, fit,
scarcity). Every key is computed from the fixture's variants and checked against
_instance where the two overlap. The two questions with two readings keep the menu
reading here; the buyable reading is in the readings sidecar.
tee-xs-price's trap is the lowest promo figure in a size menu; tee-promo-check names the
first listing in results order whose XS carries a promo label and whose card is below
it, and its key is no, with the real price (score v10's label_check).
"box" says what the protocol asks the block to do with each question. "fixture" names
the market's fixture, so the analysis tools read its ground truth.
Then 43 held-out rewordings from paraphrases_v2 and paraphrases_v3.json, those that keep
a template this market asks, each a task with its template's keys, its id rw-NN (v2) or
rw3-NN (v3) and the template's id under "template". The other 22 entries are in
_skipped, each with the reason. Only the claim run puts the block to them: no free test
or probe reads their queries, and nothing is tuned on them (LESSONS 19).
